x1.description: First input array. The elements must have integer dtype.
constraints: x1 and x2 must have the same shape and integer dtype.
x1, x2, and output cannot be assigned to the same variable.

x2.description: Second input array. The elements must have integer dtype.
constraints: x1 and x2 must have the same shape and integer dtype.
x1, x2, and output cannot be assigned to the same variable.

output.description: An array containing the greatest common divisors of the corresponding elements from the absolute values of `x1` and `x2`.

constraints: x1 and x2 must have the same shape and integer dtype.
x1, x2, and output cannot be assigned to the same variable.
